extracted.name: Honey Butter
extracted.description: This sweet, creamy honey butter is delicious on cornbread, dinner rolls, and more! Find additional serving suggestions in the post above.
ingredient_lines: ½ cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, softened to room temperature
instruction_lines: In a small bowl, stir together the softened butter, honey, and salt.
Serve with jalapeño cornbread or any of the suggestions in the blog post above.
